Application Data.NAME: Green Thumb Landscaping Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Thumb Landscaping Services specializes in comprehensive garden and landscaping solutions, including lawn maintenance, tree trimming, garden design, irrigation installation, and seasonal clean-up services. Our dedicated team focuses on enhancing outdoor aesthetics while promoting healthy plant growth and environmental sustainability. We pride ourselves on using environmentally friendly practices and maintaining a safe working environment for our employees and clients.
